---
name: Scraper request
about: Request support for a new job board, ATS, or company site
title: "[SCRAPER] "
labels: enhancement, scraper
assignees: ''

---

**Site/ATS Name and URL**
Provide the name of the ATS (e.g., Personio, Rippling) or the specific company site URL.

**Estimated job volume**
Roughly how many jobs does this source typically list? (e.g., 500+ across 10 companies, or 50 jobs for a single site).

**Requires Playwright?**
Does this site heavily rely on JavaScript rendering or bot protection? (Yes/No/Unsure)

**Has public API?**
Is there a publicly accessible JSON or XML API available for this board? (Yes/No/Unsure)

**Notes on anti-scraping measures**
Please provide any details if you noticed Cloudflare, DataDome, or other aggressive anti-scraping layers on the target.
